t: You're looking at Lowndes Square, a grand garden square at the north-west end of Belgravia. Pale stucco terraces, cream and white, surround a long rectangular garden that runs alongside Sloane Street. From the north-west corner you can see a corner of the Harvey Nichols store, with Knightsbridge tube station beyond. Lady Mary Whitley, a second cousin of Elizabeth the Second, was born here, and her family connection to the royal house runs through her relation, the Marquess of Cambridge. Geoffrey Lubbock also lived on the square.
